item.title: EplayerX 1.2.33
item.description:
## 更新内容
- 统一演员与人物详情页，改善人物介绍、作品浏览和返回导航体验。 - 提升人物头像清晰度，让搜索、首页和详情页中的人物图片保持一致。 - 优化媒体库扫描：优先完成影片识别，再补充剧集 NFO 信息；改善中断恢复和临时网络错误后的重试。 - 修复未观看提醒在刷新后重复安排的问题，改善提醒时间的稳定性。 - 改进音轨语言名称显示与多语言文本。
需要 macOS 12.0 或更高版本，请按 Mac 芯片选择 Apple Silicon 或 Intel 安装包。
## What’s New
- Unified cast and person detail pages for smoother biographies, filmography browsing, and back navigation. - Improved portrait clarity and consistency across search, Home, and detail pages. - Improved library scanning by completing title recognition before importing episode NFO metadata, with better interruption recovery and retries after temporary network errors. - Fixed repeated rescheduling of unwatched reminders after refreshes for more consistent delivery times. - Improved audio track language names and localized text.
Requires macOS 12.0 or later. Choose the Apple Silicon or Intel download for your Mac.
